title: parse_id_cred: missing support for compact kid and multi-parameter maps
description:
Root Cause: The parse_id_cred() function at credential.rs:108-135 only accepts CBOR maps starting with 0xa1 (single-element maps). This prevents parsing:
1. RFC 9528 "compact kid" encoding where ID_CRED can be a bare CBOR integer (e.g., 0x2d = -14) or bare bstr
2. Multi-element maps (0xa2-0xa8) containing full COSE key info (kty, crv, kid)
3. x5t (label 34) which is encoded as 0x18 0x22 (2-byte label) and has array value [algorithm, hash]

Affected Tests:
- id_cred_accepts_compact_kid_and_rfc9529_x5t (line 109 rejects 0x2d != 0xa1)
- id_cred_accepts_sorted_and_unsorted_literal_maps (line 109 rejects 0xa3)
- id_cred_preserves_multi_parameter_maps_and_identifies_references (same)

Location: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/credential.rs:108-135

Suggested Fix: Extend parse_id_cred() to handle three wire formats:
1. Compact int kid (0x00-0x17, 0x20-0x37, 0x18/0x38 for larger) - wrap in canonical form {4: bstr(cbor_encode(int))}
2. Compact bstr kid (0x40-0x5b) - wrap in {4: bstr}
3. Map format (0xa1-0xa8) - iterate all key-value pairs, extract kid/x5t reference, preserve full encoding

Error Type: Missing feature implementation - breaks RFC 9528/9529 compliance
